subject.title: Workspaces: add stream and computed bindings

question: Should Workspaces ship stream and computed bindings now while command bindings remain deferred, and if so where should the deferred command capability remain tracked?
rationale: Technical review cannot decide whether the canonical request should be narrowed or closed while a meaningful requested capability remains absent.

options.title: Land Narrowed Scope
options.body: After proof and upgrade review, merge stream and computed support while removing closing syntax or opening a canonical command-binding follow-up.

options.title: Complete Canonical Scope
options.body: Keep this PR open until a separately reviewed command-binding design is included, accepting the larger security and review surface.

options.title: Defer Binding Expansion
options.body: Pause or close the PR until the Workspaces roadmap owner sponsors the expanded binding contract and migration behavior.

recommendation.title: Land Narrowed Scope
recommendation.body: After proof and upgrade review, merge stream and computed support while removing closing syntax or opening a canonical command-binding follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main Workspaces architecture and its plugin, UI, persistence, and security boundaries were introduced through this person's merged work.
